Name: Lesh's Sweet Elliott
Author: LeshtheWanderer
Description:
I married Elliott on my first ever play through of Stardew and he's been my favorite bachelor ever since. He is beyond sweet and kind, from basically the moment you meet him. I never would've expected the amount of hate this man gets in this community, like are we talking about the same character?? It's this lack of love though, that has inspired me to create and share my own art of this lovely poet. I can see why, I suppose, his OG portraits could throw someone off, so hopefully my work can shine a new light on him for some of you. If not, then at least the lovers of this lover can continue to appreciate him with me.

No matter your view, thank you for taking the time to look at my mod. ♥ May you have a lovely day/night, stranger.

Also, yes, I gave him freckles, aren't they so cute? You may also be able to guess what other game I've been obsessed with lately based off of the swimsuit I gave him, lol.
